help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find guides, track complaints, emergency numbers, and contact civic officers
help.invalidIdError: Please enter a valid complaint ID format (e.g. NMF-2026-00427)
help.guideReportSteps: 1. Tap the Report button.|2. Take or upload a clear photo of the problem.|3. Select the matching category.|4. Verify GPS location & add short description.|5. Review and submit to receive your Complaint ID.
help.guideTrackSteps: 1. Open 'My Reports' from the bottom bar or enter ID above.|2. Tap on any issue card to view detailed timeline.|3. Check live status updates from assigned department.
help.guideConfirmTitle: How to confirm an existing issue
help.guideConfirmSteps: 1. Open the Nearby map view.|2. Tap an existing issue marker in your area.|3. Tap 'I am facing this issue too'.|4. Authorities prioritize issues with more confirmations.
help.guideLanguageSteps: 1. Tap the language selector in the top header.|2. Choose your language: English, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, or Malayalam.|3. The entire interface updates immediately.
help.guideLocationTitle: How to turn on GPS location
help.guideLocationSteps: 1. Ensure Location/GPS is turned ON in your phone settings.|2. Allow browser location permission when prompted.|3. The app will automatically pin your exact coordinates.
help.faq1Q: How long does a civic fix take?
help.faq1A: Most emergency problems like water bursts or electric hazards are addressed within 24-48 hours. General road repairs, potholes, and streetlight maintenance typically take 3 to 7 working days.
help.faq2A: Reports are rejected if the photo is unclear, the issue is on private property outside municipal jurisdiction, or if it is an exact duplicate of an ongoing work order.
help.faq3Q: Can I report an issue anonymously?
help.faq3A: Yes. Your phone number and email are kept strictly confidential and never displayed publicly. Only civic authorities see your contact for verification.
help.faq4A: Reported: Submitted to system. Verified: Inspected by officer. Assigned: Handed to field department. In Progress: Repair work started. Resolved: Fix completed. Rejected: Cannot be resolved.
help.faq5Q: What if the issue is not fixed after it is marked resolved?
help.faq5A: When an issue is marked resolved, citizens who reported or confirmed it receive a prompt. Tapping 'No, Still an Issue' automatically reopens the ticket for senior inspection.
help.faq6Q: Is my exact personal location shared publicly?
help.faq6A: No. Only the location of the public civic issue itself is displayed on the community map. Your personal whereabouts are never tracked or revealed.
